sentences.text: Aurornis possessed clawed wings and a long bony tail.
Fossil evidence shows traces of downy feathers on Aurornis's tail, chest, and neck.
The species Aurornis xui was first described and named in 2013 by a team led by Pascal Godefroit.
A 2017 re-evaluation of the Harlem Archaeopteryx specimen found Aurornis to be an anchiornithid.
Analysis confirmed Aurornis came from the Tiaojishan Formation, dated to the late Jurassic (Oxfordian stage) approximately 160 million years ago.
A 2014 analysis by Brusatte et al. recovered Aurornis outside Avialae, classifying it as a troodontid closely related to Anchiornis.
